properties.title: Kaguya GRS Nuclide Map - Calcium (CaO)
properties.lri:data_use_note: CaO abundance (wt%) from the Kaguya GRS Nuclide Map at 1° resolution (~30 km). High CaO is associated with plagioclase-rich highland anorthosite; useful for mapping anorthositic crust extent, complementing the coarser LP GRS calcium product.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Raw UInt16 binary (GRS_NMAP_Ca_090210_090527.img, detached PDS3 label) read via GDAL's PDS driver and converted to CaO wt% using gdal_calc.py with the label formula raw x 0.01 - 0. Reassigned from the PDS driver's projected CRS (metres) to IAU:30100 (degrees, same sphere and grid) and written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
properties.lri:quality_note: Values represent CaO (calcium oxide) mass fraction, per the source label's COMMENT_TEXT. The observed maximum of 20.00 wt% corresponds to the CaO content of anorthite, the calcium-rich plagioclase feldspar dominant in the lunar highlands.

processing_script.title: Exact processing commands used to generate the COG
